title: This crazy simple app makes $50K/month
promo_conflict: Starter Story promotional framing; guest shows RevenueCat dashboard

stated_problem.quote: And I found out that if someone wanted to get apps in 20, 26, there was absolutely no place for them to go.
stated_problem.speaker: Lino

idea.name: AbMax (niche abs fitness app)
idea.one_liner: Subscription mobile app that scans users' abs, scores them and gives a personalised abs plan and workout programs, grown via an equity-partner creator plus Meta/TikTok ads
idea.offer: ab scan/score, custom abs plan, pre-made training programs

key_quotes.quote: And we partnered up with a big fitness influencer on social media in return for some equity
And we found out that our meta ads were running at like a two, two to 2.5x for us.
Our product is super niche, which is why I think we're performing extremely, extremely well.

claims.quote: Okay, so our monthly revenue is just about $55,000 this month.
And we are currently have 16,000 downloads in the past 28 days.
And we have just over 3000 active paying customers.

claims.claim: On pace for $60K this month, five months after launch
claims.quote: I launched my first app at Max about five months ago, and now we're on pace to hit 60K this month.

claims.claim: Just over $7,000 revenue in first month
claims.quote: And then after the first month, we did just over $7,000 in revenue.

claims.claim: Early UGC deals got to $3-4K revenue at 5-10% margins
claims.quote: We were running at like five to 10%, which is why I came out with the idea.

claims.claim: Meta ads 2-2.5x ROAS; TikTok 4-5x on same creatives
claims.quote: We're able to get four to five X for us on the same creatives
I would reach out to them and pay them like $100 for 10 videos

acquisition_channels.details: big fitness influencer given equity to create content
Meta ads then TikTok ads behind creator content
faceless TikTok slideshows posted manually; micro-influencer UGC

ideas.delivery: mobile app built with Lovable then Vibecode/'work' tool; Supabase auth, PostHog analytics
ideas.other_uk_rules: DMCC Act subscription contract rules; UK GDPR and ICO Children's Code (users from age 15, body images); health claims advertising rules
